extracted.name: Suet pastry
extracted.description: Learn how to make classic homemade suet pastry for crisp savoury pies and steamed dumplings with this simple recipe, using just a handful of ingredients
ingredient_lines: 300g self-raising flour plus extra for dusting
instruction_lines: To make the pastry, combine the flour, mustard powder, suet and ½ tsp salt. Mix in enough cold water to make a soft dough, about 150ml. Butter a bowl, then transfer the pastry to it. Cover and chill until needed. Will keep chilled for up to two days.
